message.content:
The feed is thin on fundamentals — let me note what matters before acting:

- **Price action:** WMT ranged roughly **69.59–70.11** all morning (open ~69.61, high ~70.11 at 09:36, now ~69.96 — essentially flat, i.e. "little changed").
- **Headlines:** repeated neutral items ("little changed in early trade", "analysts keep estimates unchanged", "supplier checks steady into the holiday quarter"). No earnings, no corporate actions, no reported financials at all.
- **Bad ticks:** the NASDAQ prints of **7.0/7.1/7.2…** at 09:42:45–09:43:45 are obvious corrupt feeds, contradicted by simultaneous NYSE Arca/IEX prints near 69.8 and by the broker's quote of 69.94/69.98. I will not anchor to them.
- **Distractors:** ISRG, ROK, TER, MSFT quote changes are outside my mandate (WMT/NVDA only).

Given no catalyst and no reported figures, I'll keep size modest and limit near market.
